No. PA/N.-W. F.
P./Legis:1/2003/27659, dated 25-9-2003.---The North-West Frontier Province
Hydel Development Fund (Amendment) Bill, 2003,having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of North-West Frontier Province on the 5th
September, 2003 and assented to by the Governor of the North-Frontier Province
on 16th September, 2003 is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Legislature of the North-
It is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the North-West Frontier Province
Hydel Development Fund (Amendment) Act, 2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once
